MODAL.TITLE: Evaluate code
MODAL.PUBLIC_LABEL: Make public; I understand the risks
MODAL.CODE_DESCRIPTION: Paste the JavaScript to execute, or leave this empty when uploading a source file.
MODAL.FILE_DESCRIPTION: Upload a JavaScript source file instead of pasting code above.
MODAL.DURATION_DESCRIPTION: Choose how long to keep the result before it is deleted.
MODAL.EXPORT_DESCRIPTION: Attach a Markdown report containing the evaluated code, result and debugging context.
MODAL.PUBLIC_DESCRIPTION: Anyone in this channel can see the result, evaluated code and attached diagnostics.

INVALID_EXPORT: Select whether to export the evaluation result.
INVALID_PUBLIC: Choose whether to make the evaluation response public.
SOURCE_REQUIRED: Enter code or upload a source file.
SOURCE_CONFLICT: Provide either code or a source file, not both.
SOURCE_FILE_INVALID: Upload one nonempty UTF-8 .js, .mjs or .txt file no larger than 1 MiB.
SOURCE_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The source file could not be read. Upload it again and retry.
